title: Twins OF Byron Buxton to undergo season-ending hip surgery Sept. 18
content:
MINNEAPOLIS — Byron Buxton is set to undergo season-ending hip surgery on Sept. 18.

Buxton will have arthroscopic surgery on his right hip, Minnesota Twins manager Derek Shelton said. He is on the injured list for the third time this season while dealing with a hip impingement.

Though the team doesn’t have a timeline for how long the three-time All-Star will need to recover, the hope is Buxton will be ready for the start of the 2027 season.

Buxton has dealt with hip issues multiple times in his career, dating back to the 2021 season. He suffered a recurrence in mid-May and has dealt with hip soreness since, missing games twice before he was first placed on the IL before the All-Star break.

This story will be updated.
